items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: Tokens, paper stocks, pens, frames, the appearance runtime, FinelinerDefs, cn and the pen's seed and filters. Every other item builds on it; make src/fineliner/styles/fineliner.css your Tailwind entry.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Alert Dialog, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: appearance-control
items.title: Appearance Control
items.description: Every appearance setting (light, paper, pen, hand, line boil, containers, labels, density) as segmented controls and pen swatches.

items.name: article-01
items.title: Article 01
items.description: A journal post: a lettered RoomHeader with the issue's EditionNumber, prose in Typography with a drop cap, a PullQuote, a HandNote in the margin and ReadingProgress.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Aspect Ratio, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Button Group, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts drawn with the page's one pen: drawnBar, drawnCurve, drawnDot and drawnSector draw strokes through the exact data points, and series are told apart by solid, outline, dotted and lined marks rather than colour.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code Block, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Context Menu, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Dashboard 01
items.description: The shop's week: four figures in the typewriter, guests by day drawn by the pen, the records on hold and the next sessions.

items.name: drawing
items.title: Drawing
items.description: Drawing, Lettering and PenMark: objects, scenes, words and marks drawn by the pen from their seeds as inline SVG, with line boil and draw-on.

items.name: drawn-border
items.title: Drawn Border
items.description: The label's border round a region: four pen strokes that run past or stop short of their corners, optionally doubled, in CSS.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Dropdown Menu, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: edition-number
items.title: Edition Number
items.description: An edition number, Nº 0412, in the typewriter, optionally of a total, or set on the spine.

items.name: empty-01
items.title: Empty 01
items.description: Empty states with drawings: a first run, no search results and nothing booked, each with one action.

items.name: hand-note
items.title: Hand Note
items.description: An aside in the hand voice with a drawn arrow toward what it is about, in the margin on wide screens and under its line on phones.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero 01
items.description: A lettered wordmark beside a scene the visitor can reroll, one line of copy, the install command in a code block and two actions.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Hover Card, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Input Group, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: Input Otp, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: label-card
items.title: Label Card
items.description: A label from a bottle or a sleeve: a drawing inside a drawn border, a lettered title, a kicker and spine text set bottom to top.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Message Scroller, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Native Select, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Navigation Menu, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: pen
items.title: Pen
items.description: The pen engine, framework-free: seeded strokes, shapes and sheets, the object library with every collection, scenes, lettering and pen marks, as SVG strings on a server, at build time or in the browser.

items.name: price-tag
items.title: Price Tag
items.description: A hanging price tag: a drawn tag with a punched hole and string, the price in the typewriter, an old price struck through by the pen.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Pricing 01
items.description: Three memberships on hanging price tags, a monthly or yearly segmented control, ticked features and questions in an accordion.

items.name: pull-quote
items.title: Pull Quote
items.description: A quote set large in the reading face against a pen rule, its quotation marks drawn by the pen.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio Group, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: reading-progress
items.title: Reading Progress
items.description: A pen line along the top of the page that draws itself as the reader scrolls an article.

items.name: record-sleeve
items.title: Record Sleeve
items.description: A square record sleeve: a drawing on the front, the title lettered, the catalogue number on the spine and the record's edge peeking out.

items.name: room-header
items.title: Room Header
items.description: A page head: a scene drawn by the pen with the title lettered beside or under it, drawn on the first time it is seen.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll Area, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Settings 01
items.description: A narrow settings column: profile, every appearance setting through AppearanceControl, notifications as switches, and closing the account behind an alert dialog.

items.name: sign-in-01
items.title: Sign In 01
items.description: Sign in with email and password or a link by email, beside a scene drawn by the pen; errors in the correction pen.

items.name: tasting-note
items.title: Tasting Note
items.description: A wine on the list: name and producer, grape, region and year in the typewriter, the note in the hand voice, the price and a drawing.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle Group, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: track-list
items.title: Track List
items.description: Side A and side B: numbers and durations in the typewriter, titles in the reading face, dotted leaders, the playing track marked by the pen.

items.name: use-highlighted-code
items.title: Use Highlighted Code
items.description: useHighlightedCode: Shiki loaded lazily, one grammar at a time, with tokens mapped to one pen (bold keywords, italic strings, quiet comments) for CodeBlock.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: Use Mobile
items.description: Use Mobile, in the Fineliner style.

items.name: fineliner
items.title: Fineliner
items.description: Every part of Fineliner: the base, the pen engine and every component. Blocks are sample pages, so they install one at a time.
